caption:
The button that decides your reach isn't the heart. It's the paper plane.

Mosseri has said sends are slightly more important than likes for reaching people who don't follow you — and reach from non-followers is where new customers come from.

A like is someone agreeing with you. A send is someone putting their own reputation behind you, in a private conversation, to a person they actually know. One of those is worth money.

So stop writing posts that are agreeable and start writing posts that are useful to a specific third person. The test is literally: would someone send this to a friend with "look at this"?

That reframes everything. A post that makes you look smart gets likes. A post that makes the sender look smart gets sends.

Write the second one.
